FREQUENTLY ASKED

Questions

Everything you need to know about your stay at StayNest.

NEED TO KNOW

How Can We Help?

What time is check-in and check-out?

+

Check-in starts at 2:00 PM and check-out is until 12:00 PM. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability.

Do you provide airport pickup?

+

Yes, StayNest provides comfortable airport transfer services. You can contact our team to arrange your pickup in advance.

Can I cancel my booking?

+

Yes, booking cancellation is available according to the cancellation policy applicable to your reservation.

Is breakfast included in the room price?

+

Breakfast availability depends on the room package selected during your booking.

Do you offer free Wi-Fi?

+

Yes, complimentary Wi-Fi is available for guests throughout the hotel.
